line_evidence.text: A3.3.2 Construct queries between two tables in SQL.
• Queries must include joins, relational operators, filtering, pattern matching, and ordering data
• SQL commands: SELECT, DISTINCT, FROM, WHERE, BETWEEN, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, HAVING, ASC,
DESC, JOIN, LIKE with % wildcard, AND, OR, NOT (note: Syntax may vary in different database systems)
